description: This file implements the MessageControl class for managing message control operations, including thread management, message dispatching, and client interactions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: MessageControlImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing message control functionalities, including thread management, message dispatching, and client interactions.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Inner class representing a worker thread that calls the Dispatch method periodically.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing message settings loaded from the MessageUnit.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the callback for message collection, managing thread state accordingly.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a new client instance by ID.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a client instance by ID.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables specific message types, categories, and modules.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles message dispatching by waiting for updates and calling the callback with message data.
